title: Tracking public accessibility complaints
summary: As of August 13, a commissioner volunteered to work on a way to track public accessibility complaints and report back. On July 9, the commission voted 5-0 to explore a list of problems reported by the public, after a request to check whether county restrooms, elevators and crosswalks work for blind people. County officials will send a response letter, with no date given.
